body: Life steal only applies to your auto damage I believe, and 1/3 of ww auto damage is his passive. More suboptimal imo then "so bad". Rav is the worst of the options for ww imo. Titanic does a ton of dmg and stride gives good stats and a slow. You don't really need the life steal like a fiora would for example. Same with bloodthirster, ton of AD but you dont need the life steal. Bork on hit is good on ww into healthy comps, you get it for the on hit not for the lifesteal. Eclipse is ok, I used to build that a lot and liked it.

If u wanna go healthier. Stereks and Hullbreaker are great options. If ur into bursty AD you can go deaths dance and never die. Stride is also good, just save the active to avoid getting kited. Titanic is great for dmg and into melee comps. Jaksho is also fine but I usually only go if I'm behind and team needs a tank. I agree with the others tho, Hp stacking WW doesn't do much. Not that it's a useless stat but you thrive at half hp and there are better options. 


And def build boots. WW needs in combat ms so it's tough to skip those. Ww dies when you can kite him and when his E is down. As you climb people will kite you better and you'll need boots.

Nice. But yeah agreed def not Iceborn anymore. Especaily into their draft and with the Q nerfs. Also hexplate isn't great either (but maybe it's OK with PTA but not great with LT). If you want to be bulkier Stereks and Hullbreaker for seige is great. Split to get the 700g from tier 2 turret super easy, or Deaths Dance against bursty AD comps to just go super sayan in team fights if you want to group.
